english.notes: Section 33(1B) and (3) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 lists circumstances when the section does not apply. Defences are listed under section 33(7).

other.penalty:
Either Way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £50,000.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 33(8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
